meta.name: ai-act-readiness
meta.description: /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> — EU AI Act 6-question forcing interrogation. Use during AI-system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh as Article 113 obligations phase in (2025-02-02 / 2025-08-02 / 2026-08-02 / 2027-08-02).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统是否符合欧盟AI法案要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保AI系统符合欧盟AI法案的合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI system compliance with EU AI Act requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your AI system meets EU AI Act obligations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你回答欧盟 AI 法案的 6 个强制问题，评估你的 AI 系统是否合规，并输出风险等级、合规路径和待办事项。
howto.when: 当你输入 /cs:ai-act-readiness <系统名称> 时触发。适用于新系统上线前、部署到欧盟市场前、或年度合规审查时。

say.text: 帮我评估这个新聊天机器人是否符合欧盟 AI 法案。
say.note: Claude 会引导你回答 6 个问题并给出合规报告。

say.text: 检查我们的人脸识别系统是否属于高风险。
我们公司从部署者变成提供者，需要做什么？
say.note: Claude 会分析角色变化并列出新增义务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through 6 mandatory EU AI Act questions, assess your AI system's compliance, and output risk tier, conformity route, and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /cs:ai-act-readiness <system>. Use during new system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh.

say_en.text: Assess this new chatbot for EU AI Act compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the 6 questions and produce a report.

say_en.text: Check if our facial recognition system is high-risk.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate against Annex III categories.

say_en.text: We changed from deployer to provider, what now?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze role change and list new obligations.
